title: A Crash Nearly Shattered This Moon, and the Crater Remains

scenes.text: One crash almost broke this moon apart.
It's Mimas, a small icy moon of Saturn.
The crater, called Herschel, is about 80 miles wide. That's a third of the whole moon.
Its walls rise nearly three miles, and a peak in the middle stands about four miles high.
Cracks on the far side suggest the hit could have split the moon.
One impact, and a moon that almost wasn't.

description:
One crash almost broke this moon apart.
The Herschel crater on Saturn's moon Mimas is about 80 miles wide, a third of the moon's diameter.
What could have hit it?
first_comment: A crater a third of the moon's width. What do you think hit it?
